prompt:
You receive 5 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Images 2-4 are photos of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 5 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: Namestie sv. Rozalie, the village green in the centre of Ivanka pri Dunaji near Bratislava, Slovakia, as it was in 1960. Image 2 is the real Chapel of St Rosalia (1832) that stands on the green: a small round chapel with yellow walls, white pilaster strips, a classical pediment over the wooden double door, a low dark domed roof and a small wooden lantern with louvred arches and an iron cross. Image 3 shows the green itself: big old lindens and maples over grass, with low single-storey village houses with red-brown tiled roofs around it. Image 4 is a 1960 photo of a village street in the region: whitewashed houses, lath fences, beaten-earth roads, wooden electricity poles. Paint the green as it was in 1960 from these: grass and beaten-earth paths, a dirt road ringing the green, no paving, no modern lamps, railings, playground, pavilion or cars.

Brief: the village green with low houses, a bicycle, a covered well and the municipal notice board; resident Mrs Berta will stand on the path. A sunny afternoon on 6 June 1960, early summer: lush green leaves, warm low sunlight from the left, long soft tree shadows across the grass. Quiet village life of 1960 Czechoslovakia: plain plastered walls with slightly worn whitewash, wooden windows with lace curtains, a few hens behind the lath fence on the right.

Camera: standing on the green about 2 m high, looking straight across it; vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon is at y ~400. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the chapel stands in the middle distance (its foot at y 500, cross at y ~50); the post-office house on the left and the houses on the right stand at the back of the dirt road (their walls meet the ground at y 580); the dirt road ring runs across from y 580 to y 655; the grass of the green fills everything below y 655.

What the sketch blocks are, left to right: the post-office house on the left - a single-storey village house with pale ochre plaster, two windows with lace curtains, a weathered plank door with a small white enamel sign above it that reads POŠTA, a small post box on the wall, a red-brown tiled hipped roof; a wooden electricity pole with a crossarm; the mouth of a narrow dirt street with a lath fence, leading away between the houses; lindens on the far part of the green; the Chapel of St Rosalia in the middle distance with a little path to its door; behind it the far ring of low houses with tiled roofs; the dirt road leaving the square at the back right between the trees; a low house; the municipal notice board under a small roof with a few pinned sheets; whitewashed village houses along the right side with a lath fence in front of their gardens and a big linden trunk; the canopy of old lindens and maples over the top left and top right; the grass of the green with beaten-earth paths in front.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 165-375, y 420-712 of the 1920x1080 frame (9-20 % from the left, 39-66 % from the top): the old village well standing on the grass: a round stone well ring closed by a heavy wooden plank lid, under a small gabled shingle roof on two wooden posts, with a windlass beam.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 1200-1462, y 548-704 of the 1920x1080 frame (62-76 % from the left, 51-65 % from the top): a black 1950s bicycle with a leather saddle leaning against the front of the notice board, both wheels on the grass.
The post-office door is the area of the layout sketch at x 398-502, y 396-582 of the 1920x1080 frame (21-26 % from the left, 37-54 % from the top); the narrow street between the houses on the left is the area of the layout sketch at x 585-710, y 440-615 of the 1920x1080 frame (30-37 % from the left, 41-57 % from the top); the road at the back right is the area of the layout sketch at x 1045-1185, y 440-615 of the 1920x1080 frame (54-62 % from the left, 41-57 % from the top); the dirt road continues out of the left edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 0-60, y 672-1002 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 62-93 % from the top)) and the path out of the right edge (the area of the layout sketch at x 1860-1920, y 672-1002 of the 1920x1080 frame (97-100 % from the left, 62-93 % from the top)).

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 606-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 56-94 % from the top) is the open grass of the village green with its beaten-earth paths and, at its back, the dirt road - flat ground with no kerb, no step, no ditch and nothing standing on it: no benches, no carts, no stones, no tree trunks, no posts. Only grass, earth, light and tree shadows.
NPC zone at x 635-765, y 460-760 of the 1920x1080 frame (33-40 % from the left, 43-70 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 760.

Fiction rules: no house numbers, no names, no shop signs, no posters with text, no logos, no red stars or slogans, no cars, no people. The only lettering in the picture is POŠTA on the small enamel sign above the post-office door; the notice board sheets and the chapel frieze show no readable text and no digits. A few hens behind the fence are the only animals.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
